signals.text: Revenue grew 21% a year over 3 years vs 29% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 27% vs revenue at 21%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 77 bps in 3 years (18.2% → 19.0%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 30 days in 3 years (20 → 50).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 101% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 21% a year over 3 years vs 29% over 5: growth is slowing.
Working-capital days lengthened by 30 days in 3 years (20 → 50).

guidance.statement: We want to be in the 16 to 17% range, that is our aspirational goal.
guidance.quote: we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration.

guidance.statement: We expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million towards the Nagarro transaction over next two quarters.
guidance.quote: Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction.

delivered.statement: Delivered USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27, growing 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20% Y-o-Y.
EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 15%, translating to an EBIT growth of 1.6% Q-o-Q and 19.5% Y-o-Y.
Operating profit after tax came in at 10.6% and reported PAT at 7.5% due to 3.1% Nagarro one-time expenses.
Total contract value for the quarter stood at USD 633.5 million, with new bookings TCV at USD 367.1 million.
Total headcount stood at 29,598, an increase of 958 from the previous quarter, with 85.8% utilization.
Secured approximately 94.04% of Nagarro share capital at the expiry of the additional acceptance period.

calls.tone: confident on demand, growth and AI capabilities, cautious on margins and near-term macro friction

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether lower sequential TCV numbers reflect slower decision-making or deal size contraction.
Concerned about lower incremental margins in the high-tech segment due to large deal ramp-ups.
Pressed on the sharp increase in intangibles and third-party software license costs on the balance sheet.

business.summary: Persistent Systems provides digital engineering, enterprise modernization, and software product development services, leveraging proprietary AI platforms like SASVA to drive software reinvention, cloud optimization, and automation for global enterprises.

segments.name: Software, High-Tech and Emerging
segments.note: Grew 28.5% year-on-year, driven by software reinvention offerings.

segments.name: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
segments.note: Grew 16.2% year-on-year, driven by vendor consolidation and modernization.

guidance.statement: The net new deal will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis.
guidance.quote: This is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

guidance.statement: The contract value is roughly $650 million plus over 6.5 years.
guidance.quote: This is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.

guidance.statement: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS and Reported EPS accretive in Year 1.
guidance.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.

guidance.statement: Leverage is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.
guidance.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer acceptance. So, at 50% plus 1 share to 100%, it is expected to reduce down to 1X by FY2030.

delivered.statement: Persistent FY26 revenue stands at roughly $1.654 billion, with a run rate of more than $1.7 billion.
Persistent margins stand at roughly 15.6% and PAT margin stands at about 12.6%.
Nagarro TTM revenue is approximately $1.14 billion (one billion Euro).

calls.tone: confident on strategic growth, integration prospects, and deal synergies, cautious on near-term detailed guidance until regulatory approvals

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned BaFin queries on Nagarro's books and the high premium paid for the acquisition.
Questions raised on how a flat-revenue asset with margin pressures can be successfully turned around.
Concerns regarding the complexity of a two-year integration plan and maintaining growth momentum.

guidance.statement: We are marching towards the $2 billion run rate by FY27 steadily.
guidance.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

delivered.statement: Achieved USD 436 million in Q4 FY26, a 3.2% quarter-on-quarter and 16.2% year-on-year growth.
EBIT margin for Q4 FY26 came in at 16.3%, translating to an EBIT growth of 21.4% QoQ.
Profit After Tax for the quarter was 13.1%, translating to a PAT of 20.4% QoQ and 33.7% YoY.
Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 600.8 million, with new bookings of USD 428.9 million.
Full year FY26 revenue came in at USD 1.65 billion, translating into 17.4% YoY growth.
EBIT margin for the full year FY26 came in at 15.6%, representing a 90 bps improvement YoY.

calls.tone: cautiously optimistic on demand and macro, confident on AI capability build and reaching the $2 billion run rate

pushback.gist: Analysts asked about the sequential softness and vertical contributions in top 5 accounts.
Scepticism on whether API-driven frameworks accrue value away from SIs to OEMs.
Questions on company exposure to PE channel and impact of SaaS headwinds on demand.
Inquiry into cannibalization rates in the OPD business as SDLC life cycles compress.

guidance.statement: We remain firmly on track, advancing towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027.
guidance.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.

guidance.statement: We are progressing towards our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31.
guidance.quote: assessed our progress towards our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31

guidance.statement: Effective Tax Rate for FY26 will be in the range of 20% to 24%.
guidance.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.

delivered.statement: Q3 FY26 revenue reached $422.5 million, up 4.0% quarter-on-quarter and 17.3% year-on-year.
EBIT margin for Q3 FY26 was 14.4%, impacted by new labor code provisions.
Profit After Tax for Q3 FY26 was 11.6% of revenue, declining 6.8% quarter-on-quarter.
Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 674.5 million with new bookings at USD 369.1 million.
Total headcount at the end of Q3 FY26 stood at 26,711, an increase of 487.
Trailing Twelve Months attrition for the quarter came in at 13.5%.

calls.tone: confident on demand and AI adoption, cautious regarding regulatory labor code impacts

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the sharp quarter-on-quarter increase in software license revenue and its sustainability.
Analysts probed whether the tool-driven pricing margin benefit was from a single deal or repeatable.
Analysts questioned how Persistent's hi-tech vertical is growing while peers face macro headwinds.

guidance.statement: Maintain EBIT margins in the 16%–17% range over the long term.
guidance.quote: This performance remains aligned with our long-term objective of maintaining EBIT margins in the 16%–17% range.

delivered.statement: Total revenue increased 23.5% to INR 147,484 Million in FY26.
EBIT grew 31.5% to INR 23,035 Million, delivering an EBIT margin of 15.6%.
Achieved carbon neutrality across Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions for the third consecutive year.
Delivered more than 30,000 AI certifications, 24,500+ hyperscaler certifications, and 2.6 million learning hours.
Achieved a 62.90% reduction in market-based emissions and 20.20% reduction in location-based emissions from FY24 baseline.
Total CSR contribution for the year amounted to INR 237.71 Million.

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic, and disciplined, emphasizing growth, operational excellence, sustainability, and leadership in the AI era.

bull.point: Delivered USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27, growing 7.8% sequentially and 20% year-on-year.

The company remains practically debt-free with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.06.
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 101% of reported profit, showing strong cash conversion.
